title: Should You Buy Caterpillar Stock With An Order Book Almost As Big As Its Annual Revenue?
summary: Caterpillar (CAT) has fallen about 26% from its 52-week high, and the argument has narrowed to two questions: does construction demand slow, and do data center orders last. Underneath both sits an order book of $72 billion, close to the $74.7 billion of revenue it generated over the trailing twelve months. What is inside that backlog is the case for looking again.
